question: Why does shining consciousness still attain the status of a void subject?
premises: Even in that condition it attains void subjecthood.
This attainment is presented as established.
inference: Even when consciousness shines, it can assume the established condition of a void subject.
uncertainties: śūnyapramātṛtvam may denote a specific experiential level rather than mere emptiness.
plain_english: When consciousness is shining, even then it attains the established state of being a void subject.
